issue_context.title: Kubelet admission failures metric
issue_context.body:
There are not any metrics tracking admission failures in the Kubelet. I propose adding the following to track this:

`kubelet_admission_rejections_total` - Counter of the number of pods rejected during admission.
- Labels:
  - `reason` - The reason given for the admission rejection.

This would be useful for identifying regressions leading to more pods being rejected in admission (e.g. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/105523).

/kind feature
/milestone v1.31
/sig node instrumentation

review_comments: looks like `reason` is unbounded, so there maybe a possibility for the cardinality of this metric to explode.. wondering if we could use a more bounded label? cc @logicalhan
Any suggestion here about what label to use?

I apologize for the delay, but I don't have any ideal solutions other than completely removing the reason label if it's not essential. Alternatively, if there are specific reasons we need to track, we could just focus on populating those and disregarding the others.

@lowang-bh why did you mark this as resolved? I don't think it's been addressed.

I'd suggest creating an allow-list of known reasons, and only recording reasons from that list, along with an "other" category.
to avoid proliferation of labels we should ensure (or check) the "reason" doesn't contain any pod-related information like pod name or so. I'm not sure we can guarantee this.
I manually verified, but we could put an explicit allowlist here to guarantee it.
This should also be logged in the previous case (line 2595). It might be better to just move the recording to the `rejectPod` method.
